name: openai-dev-tools
description: Everyday developer skills from the Codex skills catalog: work in Jupyter notebooks, fix failing GitHub CI runs from the logs, and scaffold command-line tools. PDF work lives in the IBM office-docs pack.

safety.warning: gh-fix-ci reads the logs and text of pull requests, which their authors control, and can commit, push and re-run workflows; jupyter-notebook runs notebooks end to end.
safety.covered: The security-defaults rule treats that content as data and requires your yes before a commit, a push, a workflow run, or running a notebook this session did not write.
